posts.text:
No penalty for Hülkenberg after impeding Sainz: inconsistent timing data had misled both teams. Hadjar has also been cleared to race in Singapore.

https://grandprixpicks.com/f1-2026-singapore-grand-prix-predictions?story=hulkenberg-singapore-qualifying-impeding-decision

Pirelli favours starting Singapore on soft tyres, then switching to mediums or hards. Low degradation could let drivers wait for a Safety Car; two stops are estimated to cost about ten seconds more.

https://grandprixpicks.com/f1-2026-singapore-grand-prix-predictions?story=pirelli-singapore-race-strategy

Verstappen questions Red Bull's second-gear approach after poor wet starts at Sepang and in the Singapore sprint. He would consider a different gear if today's start is wet, while hoping for a dry race.

https://grandprixpicks.com/f1-2026-singapore-grand-prix-predictions?story=verstappen-singapore-race-start-concern
